props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long to wait before closing the tooltip. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close when this trigger is clicked.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before opening the tooltip on hover. Specified in milliseconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
If `true`, the tooltip will not open when interacting with this trigger.
Note that this doesn't apply the `disabled` attribute to the trigger element.
If you want to disable the trigger element itself, you can pass the `disabled` prop to the trigger element via the `render` prop.

props.name: handle
props.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a tooltip.

props.name: payload
props.description: A payload to pass to the tooltip when it is opened.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component’s HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
Accepts a ReactElement or a function that returns the element to render.
